rv.q: A sweet, slapdash evening for fans of these talented performers
This 90-minute trip down memory lane is a loving and lighthearted reminder of how finding joy and camaraderie in community is essential to braving the world as a big girl.
Mama, I’m A Big Girl Now is a pleasing and satisfying musical evening as well as trip down memory lane for musical theatergoers.
All the more reason to catch their non-stop, often uproarious act.
Marissa Jaret Winokur, Laura Bell Bundy, and Kerry Butler are three powerhouses who prove time can’t stop the beat of their talent and friendship.

Mama I’m a Big Girl Now! is exactly what the musical theatre junkie doctor ordered during these dark and upsetting days after the election, and I was reborn, taken back to the joy I felt every time I heard these ladies sing since 2003.

It is the feel-good musical that you didn't know you needed. It is sassy, enthralling, and a great deal of fun.

cn.t: Three Hairspray veterans reunite for a nostalgic, exuberant concert revue that critics find sweet and spirited, though some note it feels slight. The trio's genuine friendship and vocal prowess charm most reviewers.
